newsitem.title: LATVIA: BALTIJAS TRANZITU BANK BACK IN PROFIT IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: BALTIJAS TRANZITU BANK BACK IN PROFIT IN 1996.

text.p: Latvia's Baltijas Tranzitu Bank (Baltic Transit Bank), among the top ten banks by way of assets, said on Thursday it was back in profit in 1996.
It said in a statement it had an audited figure of 1.223 million lats in 1996 versus a loss of 282,000 lats in 1995.
"The bank has restructured its asset portfolio during 1996, as well as reorganised its loan policy, devoting its attention to crediting medium and big business," the bank said.
The bank's assets have grown by 5.85 million lats to 45.85 million lats and its own capital increased by 973,000 to 7.68 million, the bank added.
Loans and advance payments to clients came to 19.7 million lats, an increase of 3.1 million lats on the previous year.
Deposits in the bank were 31.67 million lats, an increase of four million lats, the bank added.
"The bank has considerably increased its activity in the stock market, both in Latvia and abroad, including transactions in clients name," Tranzitu added.
